title: How Priyam Raj earned his first $104 from a niche gaming blog at 16 (and how to start)
summary: Priyam recounts earning his first Google AdSense paycheck at 16 from a Clash of Clans strategy blog, ranking on search for specific terms. He explains the path (own domain, SEO traffic, AdSense) and gives advice on platform, niche choice and finding communities.

principles.text: Pick a niche you're genuinely enthusiastic about so you never run out of things to write or get bored.
principles.quote: I would just highly recommend you to uh choose a niche that you are actually Enthusiast about this way you would never have to like deal with I mean you would never have to deal with boredom

principles.text: Target very specific search queries in a niche; ranking top 3-4 on them drove all his traffic.
principles.quote: people would search for like best Town Hall 9 map and I would rank like third or fourth in that specific term on Google Search and that was like what brought me all the traffic

principles.text: Buy your own domain early; it makes a blog look credible versus a free subdomain, and it was cheap.
principles.quote: it was 125 rupees for the first year and it was a cheap deal

principles.text: Avoid platforms like Medium where you don't own your blog; use Blogspot to start free, or WordPress once you're serious.
principles.quote: I won't recommend something like medium because in that case you are totally owned I mean your blog is totally owned by them

principles.text: Diverse global traffic made AdSense income stable, averaging $400-500 a month.
principles.quote: it was actually from a diverse amount of countries like India us basically everywhere I was traffic from everywhere and so the income was pretty stable

principles.text: Find communities (e.g. on Twitter) of people doing the same thing, search niche-site earnings, and learn from what they do.
principles.quote: just search for this term called Niche sites on the Twitter or just something like Niche site earnings and then you would uh just find a lot of people trying to do the same thing as you
